name: Proof of Human Work Writing Tool

mentions.name: Proof of Human Work Writing Tool
mentions.description: A transparency writing tool that cryptographically proves a human actually typed the text they claim to have written, such as research papers, news articles, and assignments. It captures behavioral signals during composition to make the writing process very hard to automate or fake, and lets readers verify authorship authenticity.
mentions.problem: In the AI-generated slop era, it is hard to verify whether written works were genuinely produced by a human rather than automated or faked.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a pro transparency writing tool that cryptographically proves a human actually typed what they claim to have written (research papers, news articles, assignments etc) . It captures behavioral signals during composition, makes it very hard to automate or fake the writing process, and lets readers verify authorship authenticity.
